subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should markerless Microsoft Teams channel/group HTML stubs trigger Graph media lookup by default, or only behind an explicit `channels.msteams` opt-in?
rationale: Current behavior drops real inbound attachments, but the previous fix intentionally avoided Graph fallback for mention-only HTML stubs; the safe permanent default is a product/operator tradeoff, not just a mechanical code change.

options.title: Use a default-off Graph fallback
options.body: Land or request a canonical fix that preserves current default behavior while adding an explicit documented opt-in for markerless channel/group attachment retrieval.

options.title: Accept broad default fallback
options.body: Land a broad fallback if maintainers accept the extra Graph lookups and possible noisy diagnostics as the default cost of making attachments work automatically.

options.title: Ask for one unified PR
options.body: Pause both open candidates until one branch covers channel top-level messages, channel replies, and group chats with focused tests and live proof.

recommendation.title: Use a default-off Graph fallback
recommendation.body: Land or request a canonical fix that preserves current default behavior while adding an explicit documented opt-in for markerless channel/group attachment retrieval.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about Teams plugin product policy and config-surface tradeoffs, and this owner has the strongest feature-history signal for the plugin boundary and config direction.
